name: Witness Script Loader
author: Tom Lorimer

sections.description:
Witness is a powerful social proof tool designed exclusively for Teachable school owners that helps you increase conversions and engagement on your Teachable school.

Add Witness to your Teachable school directly from the Teachable APP HUB and integrate with your WordPress site using this plugin.

This plugin allows you to easily add the Witness script to your WordPress site, ensuring that your visitors see real-time notifications of user activity, boosting trust and encouraging sign-ups.

Take advantage of our free 14-day trial period with no credit card required.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv3 or later. For more information, see https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/witness-script-loader directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Settings’ -> ‘Witness WP Plugin’ page to configure the script hash.
sections.faq:
How do I find my script hash?

Your script hash can be found in your Witness Social Proof account dashboard under the ‘Setup Witness’ area. Copy and paste this value into the plugin settings page.
